title: Deep-learning reconstruction improved rated image quality in low-dose chest CT
summary: In a retrospective study of 90 patients, deep-learning reconstruction of low-dose chest CT images was compared with iterative reconstruction and standard-dose images. The study reported improved image-quality ratings for deep-learning reconstruction; it did not test patient outcomes.
ai_technology: Deep-learning image reconstruction for low-dose chest CT.
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University; Dijon Bourgogne University Hospital; Keimyung University Dongsan Medical Center

evidence.tested: The study compared 45 low-dose and 45 conventional CT examinations; radiologists assessed image quality and diagnostic confidence across reconstruction methods.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective image-quality study; no prospective diagnostic-outcome or patient-benefit evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning image reconstruction for low-dose chest CT.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
